simple.meaning: סוּף (çûwph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to snatch away, i.e. terminate.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Esther, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Amos, and 1 more, beginning at Esther 9:28. Its contexts include city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סוּף (H5486).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: סוּף (çûwph) / H5486 is traced through Esther 9:28, Psalms 73:19, Isaiah 66:17, Jeremiah 8:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor their memory perish from their offspring,† or, seed

“Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, behind one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says Yahweh.
“ ‘I will utterly consume them, says Yahweh.
I will strike the winter house with the summer house;
I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.
